mechanicalReview.note: No qualified technician has reviewed the sequence, and nothing has been validated on a physical vehicle. The timing-belt content is an educational overview.

releases.summary: First complete path: configuration → job → preparation → 16 steps bound to a selectable 2JZ-GE VVT-i timing assembly → final checks. 37 components in the inventory, all 37 exported as selectable geometry across a core and an access layer.

assets.role: Engine structure and timing drive; loaded first.
Assemblies removed for access; loaded after the core layer.
Export manifest: hashes, budgets, per-component records and build notes.
Static illustration and text alternative to the 3D view.

unresolvedGaps: No dimension is measured. Every length and position is estimated from photograph proportions, scaled against the published 86 mm bore.
RM718U has not been read from a licensed copy. Page locators and the phase order come from third-party mirrors and are marked mirror-derived.
No torque, force, clearance or timing specification is entered. 11 specification slots are present and empty.
No OEM part number is established; the Lexus EPC vehicle selector did not load during the source review.
Timing marks, belt tooth count and belt pitch are not modelled, so the model cannot be used as a timing reference.
Tooth, groove and rib counts in the geometry follow stated illustrative pitches and are not part data.
Grouped geometry (radiator assembly, VVT-i oil hardware, cylinder-head covers, manifolds, rear covers) stands in for several physical pieces each.
Timing-cover bolts are not modelled: the source lists bolt groups of 5, 3 and 4 without a mapping to individual covers.
Whether a second timing-belt idler exists on this configuration is unconfirmed.
Federal versus California emissions differences in hose and connector routing are unresolved, as is the production month range used for catalog applicability.
No physical access check has been performed: the model cannot show whether a tool actually fits.
